source: NASA PDS REMS corrected UV, REMS_UVS_3401_3500
time_basis: Mars Science Laboratory sol / local mean solar time (LMST); bins are not UTC
aggregation: 15-minute LMST bins: arithmetic mean, observed min/max and valid sample count; min/max of published systematic uncertainties are kept separately. No uncertainty reduction or overlapping-band addition.
limitations: Local rover archive, actual sols 3401–3423 (2022); not live and not a global UV field. Instrument bands differ from standard UVA/UVB definitions. Zenith >55° and -999 are excluded as unavailable, not zero. Gale marker is a regional reference, not the rover position at each sample.
coverage_warning: The product filename and label nominal bounds reach sol 3500 / June 2022, but the retrieved table rows end at sol 3423. Only actual row coverage is displayed.
